aboutIntro: Weita Chen works in images. Trained as both an engineer and an artist, he takes things apart to understand how they work, then asks why each frame should exist at all. WITNESS is the core of his practice: the camera doesn't just record, it bears witness. I was here. I saw this. When AI can generate any image, witnessed reality matters more than ever.
aboutBackground: He holds a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from National Taiwan University and an MFA in Integrated Media Arts from Hunter College. Over more than a decade of independent work, he has shot and directed documentary, fiction, commercials, music videos and branded films. He was the cinematographer of the documentary REBIRTH, selected for competition at DOC NYC 2023.
